rightsRule: Use only member portraits hosted on official Texas House member pages with source attribution; reject generic chamber, seal, district, or site artwork.
notes: Primary official source for incumbent Texas House member portraits.

rightsRule: Use only candidate-specific portraits from official Texas Senate member pages with source attribution; never use the site's generic Open Graph image as a candidate portrait.
notes: Primary official source for incumbent Texas Senate portraits; generic og_image.jpg must remain excluded.

rightsRule: Use only candidate-specific official portraits or biography images hosted by the Office of the Texas Governor with source attribution.
Use only candidate-specific official commissioner portraits or field photographs hosted by the Texas General Land Office with source attribution.
notes: Official government source for Texas General Land Office officeholders.

rightsRule: Use Ballotpedia to confirm candidate identity and locate campaign or official links; do not copy Ballotpedia images without a separately documented item-level reuse basis.
notes: High-value candidate identity and downstream-source directory.

rightsRule: Use Vote Smart profiles for identity, office context, and downstream official links; do not auto-approve portrait assets without separate provenance and reuse-rights verification.
notes: Useful source-expansion directory for current and former candidates.

rightsRule: Use Wikidata only to resolve candidate identity and discover linked Wikimedia Commons files; verify the exact Commons file identity and license before approval.
notes: Structured discovery layer feeding item-level Wikimedia Commons verification.

rightsRule: Use Teach the Vote candidate profiles to confirm identity and locate campaign websites, emails, and downstream official sources; do not copy candidate images without a separate reuse basis.
notes: ATPE candidate directory covers Texas legislative and education races and can expose campaign links not present in canonical data.

rightsRule: Use Transparency USA for current race status, committee identity, and downstream campaign-source discovery only; do not reuse profile imagery without separate rights documentation.
notes: Useful for identifying active candidates and campaign committees when campaign websites are difficult to locate.

rightsRule: Use Branch candidate pages to locate campaign websites and other downstream primary sources; do not copy Branch-hosted candidate photos without independently documented reuse rights.
notes: New source-discovery directory found during active August 22 source expansion.

rightsRule: Use only Texas State Library and Archives Commission items whose item-level rights statement supports reuse and whose caption clearly identifies the candidate; preserve collection, creator, item URL, and rights statement.
notes: Official Texas archival source for historical officeholder and public-service photography.

rightsRule: Approve only after verifying the exact Portal to Texas History item identifies the candidate and provides a compatible rights statement; preserve originating institution, creator, item URL, and rights metadata.
notes: New archival source class discovered during active source expansion; rights vary by item and institution.
